_howto: GMP is filled in by hand. In 'gmp', write the IPO's NSE symbol (as shown on ipo-gmp.html / data/ipo-details.json) and its GMP in rupees, e.g. "SAMPINFRA": 38 or "DEMOFOOD": -12. Use null if there is no GMP yet. Update 'updated' every time you change GMP. 'extraIpos' is only for IPOs that are NOT on NSE (e.g. BSE SME) -- add them in the same shape as data/ipo-details.json, with a 'gmp' field.
